assets.sourceDescription: Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon Romanian municipal boxing-hall cypher scene with a packed camera-facing crowd in shadow, generated text-only with OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare at native 3840x2160, then reference-edited once with that candidate as the only image input to remove one standing spectator, complete one torso, and darken the audience. No upscaling.

OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare via Flare API; native 3840x2160 opaque PNG; original generation and corrective edit; approved flat editorial cartoon; metadata registration only, no resizing or pixel edits.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon desks from the same OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare native 3840x2160 opaque composite. Contour masks extract both desk groups, fitted to shared standing-desk coordinates; repository green-matte conversion supplies antialiased alpha. Native-alpha candidates were not used.

OpenAI Images API gpt-image-2.5-flare edit, high quality, native 3840x2160 opaque PNG; one reference edit of the earlier hotel background that moves background guests out of the protected regions; metadata registration only.

Original Romanian local call-in studio background with layered city silhouettes, generated through the OpenAI API using gpt-image-2.5-flare at native 3840x2160, high quality. Original text generation followed by reference edits for flat editorial-cartoon rendering and the skyline. Owner-approved generated pixels retained. Metadata-only provenance registration; no post-generation pixel changes, resizing, upscaling, recoloring, or compositing.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon desks from the same OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare native 3840x2160 opaque composite. Contour masks extract both desk groups, fitted to shared standing-desk coordinates; repository green-matte conversion supplies antialiased alpha. Native-alpha candidates were not used.

Original flat editorial-cartoon scene generated with OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare at native 3840x2160. Text-only generation followed by one reference edit to flatten material shading. Approved source pixels retained without resizing or pixel changes.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon desks from the same OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare native 3840x2160 opaque composite. Contour masks extract both desk groups, fitted to shared standing-desk coordinates; repository green-matte conversion supplies antialiased alpha. Native-alpha candidates were not used.
OpenAI API, gpt-image-2.5-flare; original flat editorial-cartoon nighttime creator studio; native 3840x2160; no pixel preparation, resizing or upscaling.

Built-in chat image generator; original editorial-cartoon creator desks; generated native 1672x941; bounded detached-alpha-1 cleanup of 2220 pixels; owner-authorized transparent padding of 4 pixels left/right and 2 pixels top/bottom to 1680x945. Original content pixels retained; no scaling or interpolation.

Original flat editorial-cartoon Modern Debate Studio background generated through OpenAI API, gpt-image-2.5-flare, native 3840x2160, high quality. Text-only original studio design informed by inspected research, followed by reference edits for composition and the 72-percent floor join. Approved generated pixels retained; metadata registration only. No upscaling, resizing, recoloring, or post-generation pixel preparation.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon desks reference-edited from the same OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare native 3840x2160 composite onto a green matte. The complete raster was translated down 161 pixels and each desk group was proportionally downsampled into codec-safe shared standing-desk coordinates. Repository green-matte conversion supplied antialiased alpha. No upscaling.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon studio background created with the OpenAI API, gpt-image-2.5-flare, high quality, at native 3840x2160. Reference-guided original studio design followed by a focused composition edit. Metadata-only provenance registration; no pixel preparation, resizing, repositioning, or upscaling. Runtime variants derive from this master.

Original flat cel-shaded editorial-cartoon desks generated text-only with OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare on a native 3840x2160 green-matte canvas. Complete tabletop and prop groups were proportionally downsampled and fitted into codec-safe shared standing-desk coordinates; only the lower front panels were vertically extended to the canvas edge. Repository green-matte conversion supplied antialiased alpha. No upscaling.
